java: CommandLinkClass.getRegexConcat parses endpoint heads independently through LinkDecor.getRegexDecors1/getRegexDecors2 and permits [-=.]+ arrow bodies with optional direction and style sections.
CommandLinkClass.getLinkType builds LinkType(decors2, decors1); Link.getInv and LinkType.getInversed swap endpoints and decorations for left/up directions.
Link.getLinkStrategy returns SIMPLIER. SvekEdge suppresses Graphviz arrowheads, calls ExtremityParenthesis through LinkDecor, and shortens DotPath by the extremity decoration length before paint.
ExtremityParenthesis defines radius 9, half-angle 70 degrees, fixed stroke width 1.5, and decoration length 10.
Link.idCommentForSvg emits '-backto-' when decor1 is NONE and decor2 is present, a plain '-' when both decorations are present, and '-to-' when only decor1 is present.

Cluster.getRankSame only emits a same-rank subgraph when both SvekEdge endpoint UID prefixes are ordinary SvekNode members. ClusterDotString creates a separate hidden special point for links to groups.
DotPath.moveStartPoint removes a first cubic when the requested decoration movement is at least that cubic's length, then shifts the surviving start point and first control point.
rust: EndpointDecor::Parenthesis is propagated through Relationship.from_decor/to_decor, direction inversion swaps those fields, and solid dash target-end cases reach layout and paint correctly.
The parenthesis relationship regex enumerates only )-+, -+(, and )-+( forms. It does not accept Java-valid dotted or equals shaft bodies.

render_relationship_svg forces every relationship containing Parenthesis to use a '-to-' path ID, bypassing Java's source-only and double-decoration identity branches. relationship_decorates_from/to also ignores EndpointDecor, so source-only parenthesis links emit an ordinary link comment instead of a reverse-link comment.

shortened_endpoint_points translates the first point/control and last point/control but never removes a short first cubic. On clipped package-source routes this leaves a backwards cubic that Java DotPath.moveStartPoint removes.
The group endpoint rank suppression is broad, but its SvekNode-membership rationale is supported by Java Cluster.getRankSame and no fixture-specific endpoint names are used.

Rust uses the wrong '-to-' path ID and retains an extra backwards first cubic after package clipping; Java removes the short first cubic before the 10px decoration shift.

Java uses ExternalSource-NestedTarget; Rust incorrectly inserts '-to-'.
Stroke, dash, color, fixed 1.5px arcs, and geometry match, but the Java plain-hyphen path ID is replaced with '-to-' by Rust.

Java emits one dashed reverse class link and one parenthesis arc; Rust emits no link.

Rust's pre-existing lollipop regex accepts only word endpoints, so this valid quoted Java lollipop is absent. The ordinary parenthesis relationship parser does not intercept it; this control is preserved but is not needed for the verdict.
The plain LR package-target control retains a 3.5615px vertical envelope offset. This residual is preserved as evidence but is not used to attribute a parenthesis-specific failure.

findings.summary: Java-valid dotted parenthesis relationships are silently dropped.
findings.evidence: CommandLinkClass accepts [-=.]+ bodies, but Rust's new regex only enumerates dash parenthesis forms. Both held-out dotted inputs produce a Java link and arc while Rust produces no link.

findings.summary: Parenthesis SVG path identity is wrong for source-only and both-end decorations.
findings.evidence: Rust forces '-to-' whenever either EndpointDecor is Parenthesis. Java derives identity from LinkType: source-only uses '-backto-', both-end uses a plain '-', and target-only uses '-to-'. Seven fresh solid inputs fail this rule across ordinary, styled, nested, package, and inverted links.

findings.summary: Package-source parenthesis trimming does not follow Java DotPath semantics.
findings.evidence: After compound clipping, Rust always shifts the first point/control and leaves the first cubic. Java DotPath.moveStartPoint removes a short first cubic when the 10px decoration shift consumes it. The package-source held-out contains the extra backwards cubic, and the package-to-package held-out also misplaces the target arc.

findings.summary: The arc geometry constants, target-only solid path, style ownership, and basic inversion data flow are supported.
findings.evidence: Fresh target-only ordinary and package cases pass, a left-inverted source case passes, and the styled both-end case matches stroke/color/dash/arc geometry aside from path identity.

findings.summary: No fixture-shaped logic or unexplained parity constant was found.
findings.evidence: Fresh labels do not occur in shipping crates, and every new numeric constant traces directly to ExtremityParenthesis.
